Partly. The JRC map doesn't show the loss itself. It is a 2020 forest/non-forest reference, not a loss map. It shows that the whole 2023 event area (about 0.7 ha, 1.2% of the asset) was forest at the end of 2020, so it agrees with the loss that Hansen/UMD mapped for 2023. Together with later observed years, this meets the method's corroboration rule, and the status is SUPPORTED.

Context: the MGAP 2021 map classes 0.4 ha of the area as planted eucalyptus and 0.3 ha as outside mapped forest, with no native forest. A further 0.4 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha was not counted as an event.

This does not establish deforestation, cause, legality, actor, or compliance. Hansen loss includes any stand replacement, such as cutting a plantation.
